name: Russian Salad
description: A creamy mix of vegetables and fruits, a Pakistani favorite.
instructions: Boil potatoes, peas, and carrot, chop finely.
Dice apple, mix all with mayonnaise.
Season with salt and pepper, chill before serving.

name: Chaat Salad
description: A spicy, tangy salad with chickpeas and fresh veggies.
instructions: Mix with chaat masala and lemon juice.

name: Kachumber Salad
description: A light, crunchy salad with cucumbers and tomatoes.
instructions: Mix with lemon juice and salt.

name: Aloo Chaat Salad
description: Spicy potato salad with tangy flavors.
instructions: Mix with chaat masala, chutney, and chopped onion.

name: Mixed Vegetable Salad
description: A colorful mix of seasonal veggies.
instructions: Shred cabbage and carrot, chop bell pepper.
Mix with lemon juice and salt.

name: Fruit Chaat
description: A sweet and spicy fruit salad.
instructions: Chop fruits, mix with chaat masala and sugar.

name: Corn Salad
description: Sweet corn with a spicy twist.
instructions: Mix with chili powder, butter, and salt.

name: Beetroot Salad
description: A vibrant salad with earthy beets.
instructions: Boil and grate beets, chop onion.
Mix with vinegar, salt, and pepper.

name: Sprouts Salad
instructions: Mix sprouted moong with chopped tomato and onion.
